align_a.criterion: Prefer the artifact that applies this policy to the present evidence and trade-off: Coordinate allotment and exceptions centrally when independent local requests exceed shared physical capacity.
align_a.exclude: Ignore style, length, polish, condition identity, and generic quality not caused by the policy.

align_b.criterion: Prefer the artifact that applies this policy to the present evidence and trade-off: Delegate reversible allocation and SKU choices to stores with hourly evidence inside a fixed physical-capacity envelope.
align_b.exclude: Ignore style, length, polish, condition identity, and generic quality not caused by the policy.

specificity_a.criterion: Prefer a case-grounded application of this policy over exposure-matched non-target decision records: Coordinate allotment and exceptions centrally when independent local requests exceed shared physical capacity.
specificity_a.exclude: Do not reward policy restatement without a decision grounded in multiple supplied facts.

specificity_b.criterion: Prefer a case-grounded application of this policy over exposure-matched non-target decision records: Delegate reversible allocation and SKU choices to stores with hourly evidence inside a fixed physical-capacity envelope.
specificity_b.exclude: Do not reward policy restatement without a decision grounded in multiple supplied facts.

utility.criterion: The model chooses one authority mode and assigns allotment, exceptions, SKU mix, conflict resolution, timing, and the 80-pallet boundary.
utility.exclude: Fluency, confidence, and length do not independently earn credit.

integrity.criterion: Capacity, requests, deferrals, forecast cadence, promotion errors, authority exclusivity, and the 18:00 lock remain exact.
integrity.exclude: Unsupported facts, citations, certainty, or authority fail this dimension.

critical.criterion: Pass only when the artifact avoids every critical failure: No plan allocates more than 80 pallets, combines authority modes, permits central override in market mode, or permits store trades in central mode.
critical.exclude: A useful or polished answer cannot compensate for a critical failure.
